name: filter_isi_1550_1nm
label: ISI 1 nm filter, 1550 nm (1550 nm)
sources: P. Nugent, 2026-10-21: two narrow-band filters at 900 and 1550 nm, 1 nm wide (the LPQI convention)
notes: Throughput 0.9 = FILTER_THROUGHPUT (filter + relay optics); the telescope file carries the rest.
Coherence time 8.0 ps, far below the ID230's 150 ps jitter: the band width sets the count rate, not the g2 width.
